name: Oliver Strutynski
headline: Chief Financial Officer at AlphaSights
summary:
Experienced CFO/COO with strong Finance credentials and Strategy/General Management Background.

I am currently serving as the CFO at AlphaSights, the global leader in knowledge on-demand. With close to 20 years of experience in finance, strategy, and general management, I have a proven track record of leading and scaling businesses in media, information, and technology.

Prior to AlphaSights, my journey included various CFO, COO, and CEO roles within subsidiaries of ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE, a listed German Broadcasting and Media company. Notably, as the global CFO/COO of Studio71, I built the global finance and operations team for the group, oversaw the company's rapid growth from EUR 135m in 2016 to over EUR 300m in 2021, supported fundraising and M&A for the group, drove global system roll-outs and managed the fund-raising process leading to minority investments by TF1 and Mediaset for the group.

Before joining ProSiebenSat.1 in 2013, I have advised leading companies on growth strategy, M&A and digital strategy as a consultant at McKinsey & Company. I hold an MBA from the Haas School of Business at UC Berkeley, complemented by a MS degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Carnegie Mellon University and a Diploma in Computer Science from Technische Universität München.

positions.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and COO
positions.description:
Providing Finance and Operations leadership for global multichannel network Studio 71 during a period of rapid growth from EUR 135m in 2016 to EUR over 300m in 2021.

Key Accomplishments
▪ Raised over EUR 50m from investors TF1 and Mediaset to finance international growth, managing the full deal process, structuring and negotiating the transaction, and concluding key commercial agreements with new partners
▪ Secured USD 10m in external debt to support fast-growing US operations
▪ Built global Finance organization and integrated local entities into global reporting setup
▪ Led initiative to successfully unify global operations setup, consolidating multiple internally and externally developed applications to enable expansion into new territories
▪ Negotiated and closed the acquisition of a strategic interest in Finder Studios, France
▪ Led multiple buy-side Due Diligence projects (commercial, legal, financial) on potential acquisition targets
▪ Managed all activities to setup fully operational local operating companies for Studio 71 in the UK and Italy; negotiated unified global agreement with Google/YouTube providing substantial improvement over existing local deals
▪ Oversaw global Covid19 response including remote work transition, office health & safety policies, liquidity management and bank negotiations, cost reduction, and utilization of government support programs across all S71 territories
▪ Led multiple cost review and restructuring processes in multiple territories realizing a total of over EUR 10m in annual savings in personnel expenses and opex
▪ Acted as main interface between Studio71 Group and majority shareholder ProSiebenSat.1 including participation in investor relations activities, group-wide strategic planning processes, cost reviews, and as key contact for all operations topics

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
CEO for the Games business of ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE

Key achievements
• Initiated cost reduction program resulting in short-term reduction of over 30% of monthly IT opex and 15% of all other Opex with additional savings to be realized throughout 2016
• Fully managed M&A process to explore strategic options for the business and negotiated and executed merger with Gamigo AG realizing significant value for existing shareholders
• Managed the company during transition phase during signing and closing resulting in 100% employee retention before closing and full achievement of M&A business case
• Secured funding from shareholders for largest-ever launch budget for newly launched mobile game Dawn of Gods and worked with the company's CMO to ensure profitable marketing spend
• Recruited new Managing Director for advertising business, resulting in 100%+ increase in monthly advertising sales

positions.title: Chief Financial Officer
